transcript:
[Verse 1]
Plastic oceans, melting skies
Billionaires in space while the planet fries
Healthcare’s a raffle, rent’s a scam
AI writes poems while I eat cold Spam

[Pre-Chorus]
Scroll past doom, hit the like
World’s on fire, but hey — cool bike!

[Chorus]
Late stage everything, nothing makes sense
Reality's paywalled, the rich feel tense
We're laughing through collapse, dancing through decay
Order's an illusion, chaos pays

[Verse 2]
Cops in tanks, but potholes stay
Schools get books banned every day
Stock tips from memes, war from tweets
The algorithm chooses what we eat

[Pre-Chorus]
Debt balloons, tempers snap
We're all just rats in a crypto trap

[Chorus]
Late stage everything, we meme our fate
Celebrate collapse with clickbait
Truth is dead, long live spin
Tell me who profits when we don’t win

[Bridge – spoken/screamed]
This is it.
The sequel nobody asked for.
Reboots, recalls, reruns of Rome.
Civilization’s final update: bug-ridden and insecure.

[Final Chorus]
Late stage everything, smile and grind
Buy your own chains, they’re Prime-shipped, signed
We're the joke, we’re the punchline too
Welcome to the end — brought to you by YOU.
